name: Paperwork Desk
tagline: Forward your bills and letters; it tracks amounts, deadlines and replies
description: You forward bills, leases, renewal notices, medical statements and plain letters, and it pulls out the amounts and dates that matter. Every deadline goes onto a tracked list, and reminder or reply drafts are written for you - nothing is ever sent until you approve it yourself.
author: Daniel191555486
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
